sonnet.problem: The card tells that the people of Judah and Jerusalem were sold far from home (Joel 3:6), which is serious sin. Papa Dorin still makes a junk-drawer joke on it ('so I don't think "far" is a problem'). Card 6 treats the similar v3 as heavy and has no joke. This one should show care instead of a joke.
sonnet.rule: A card that tells death, violence, abuse, serious sin or the body's private matters has no joke. He can show care instead, marked as his own ("I think this one hurts").

sonnet.problem: The card tells a summons and a prediction as events happening now: 'Armies rushing in from every side, and the LORD just... sits down.' The text says 'Let the nations be roused and advance' and 'there I will sit down to judge.' The casual 'just... sits down' also gives the LORD a nonchalant tone.
sonnet.rule: A prediction stays a prediction: "God says Tyre will fall," never "Tyre falls."
